shard.title: Subject: Television Viewing
shard.basis: the publisher's subject list, from gssrdoc in the current release (7224r3a)

questions.text: On the average day, about how many hours do you personally watch television?

Next I'd like to ask about some leisure or recreational activities that people do during their free time. As I read each activity, can you tell me if it is something you have done in the past twelve months? 
M. Record a TV program so you could watch it later.

name: tvshows
label: How often R watches TV drama or sitcoms

questions.text:
I'll now ask about some different kinds of television shows. Would you tell me how often you watch prime-time drama or situation comedy programs?  Would you say every day, several times a week, several times a month, rarely, or never? 
A. Prime-time drama or situation comedy programs.
